page.overview:
Who is Ferra & Torr?

Ferra & Torr are characters in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A pair of unidentified Outworld species consisting of a "rider" and "mount", Ferra & Torr serve as the personal bodyguards of the former Outworld Emperor Kotal Kahn.

Ferra & Torr made their debut in Mortal Kombat X, serving as minor antagonists in the game's Story Mode.

Ferra returned in Mortal Kombat 1 as the final DLC Kameo Fighter as part of the Kombat Pack.

Ferra and Torr are a symbiote pairing consisting respectively of a young female rider and a giant masked brute, and were found wandering the Tarkatan wastelands before being made to serve as new Outworld emperor Kotal Kahn's personal bodyguards. They are of an Outworld species in which the rider bonds with its mount.
